## Libraries and Data

```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
brodeur <- read_dta("MM Data.dta")
```

## Some Clean Up

```{r}
# i should remove quotes, special characters, etc. from brodeur titles (or all columns?) before I even do anything else here
brodeur_articles <- brodeur %>%
  select(c(year:article, title)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(title = str_replace_all(title, "\n", " "))
glimpse(brodeur_articles)
```

## General Set Up for API Work

```{r}
papers <- brodeur_articles$title
```


## Zenodo API

```{r}
my_key <- readLines("zenodo_api_key.txt") # don't think i even need
# Loop over all articles
for(i in 8:nrow(brodeur_articles)) {
#for(i in 1:5) {
  # Respect zenodo rate limit of 60/minute
  if(i%%60) Sys.sleep(60)
  
  # Extract article title
  title <- brodeur_articles$title[i]
  
  # Generate request URL
  zenodo_request <- request("https://zenodo.org/api") %>%
    req_url_path_append("records") %>%
    req_url_query(q = title)%>%
    req_url_query(sort = "bestmatch", size = 1)
  
  # Pull Data
  zenodo <- req_perform(zenodo_request)
  #zenodo
  
  # Flatten and extract resulting datasets
  zenodo_tbl <- zenodo %>%
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE)

  results <- zenodo_tbl$hits$hits #$title, $doi_url, etc. just pull first one? was there a query to just pull first hit i feel like there was?
  if(length(results)==0) {
    brodeur_articles[i, 'zenCount'] <- 0
    next
  }
  datasets <- results[results$metadata.resource_type.type == 'dataset',]
  
  # Pick the first result that matches the article's title
  dataset <- datasets[grepl(title, datasets$title, ignore.case = TRUE),][1,]
  
  # Store findings
  brodeur_articles[i, 'zenURL'] <- dataset$doi_url
  brodeur_articles[i, 'zenName'] <- dataset$title
  #brodeur_articles[i, 'zenCount'] <- nrow(datasets)
}
```

## Dataverse API

```{r}
for(i in 1:length(papers)){
print(i)
# Format request
  dataverse_request <- request("https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api") %>%
  req_url_path_append("search") %>%
  req_url_query(q = papers[i]) %>%
  req_url_query(sort = "score", type = "dataset", per_page = 1)
  
# Perform request, flatten
  dataverse_tbl <- req_perform(dataverse_request) %>%
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE)
  
# Skip if no results
  if(length(dataverse_tbl$data$items) == 0){
    next
  }
  
# Extract results of interest
  dataset <- dataverse_tbl$data$items %>%
    select(c(name, url))

# Store findings
  brodeur_articles[i, 'dvURL'] <- dataset$url
  brodeur_articles[i, 'dvName'] <- dataset$name
}
```
